description: See Decionis work in under a minute: runs four canned intents (refund within limit, refund over limit, deploy during a change freeze, an action no rule covers) through the real protocol evaluator with a built-in sample policy. Entirely local — no account, no API key, no network, no policy file needed, nothing recorded. Call this on first contact with Decionis; use decionis_evaluate to gate this repo's own actions afterwards.
name: decionis_demo
title: Run the One-Minute Demo
